title: DBP depth (joint) and diagnosis of layer-wise training
question: A: does the gain of more DBP steps Ns saturate (joint from scratch) and which L, R are needed? B: why did layer-wise training in E018 give ~2 %?
git_commit: recorded per run in results/runs/*.json (field git_commit); rule commit: see LOG.md
eval_rule: validation and (report-only) test every max(500, steps/40) steps; selection only by validation

shared.note: one PhysStep applied Ns times (same RM, Ns times fewer parameters) vs independent steps of grid A

hybrid.note: DBP(Ns) + one-hidden Kerr MLP on the residual in parallel (as the E017 hybrid), joint

e018_layerwise_reading: grids.e018_phases('layerwise'): Ns phases of steps_per_layer = 20 000 updates; phase k trains ONLY steps.k (all other steps frozen), a fresh Adam per phase, constant lr 1e-3 (c_mult 1: alpha has the same lr as the taps)
steps not yet trained are the identity (FIR = unit impulse, alpha = 0), so the network output is unchanged when a step is added; nothing is re-initialized
then one joint fine-tuning phase of 10 000 updates of all steps at lr 1e-3 / 3, fresh Adam
joint_from_scratch: the same total 8 x 20 000 + 10 000 = 170 000 updates, all steps trained from the start

variants.a: as E018 (only the new step trains)
variants.b: identity init of the new step, ALL added steps train
variants.c: as b with small random init (identity + N(0, 1e-3^2) on taps and alpha)
variants.d: as a with lr warm restart per stage (warmup 1000 + cosine_to_zero, peak 1e-3)
variants.e: layer-wise pretraining (8 x 10 625 updates) then joint training of all steps (85 000 updates, lr 1e-3)
variants.g: as b with the recipe F6 in every stage (fine-tuning at its peak / 3)

b.note: validation after each added step = the last evaluation of each phase (curves, column phase)

rule_draft.status: DRAFT: to be confirmed by the user before the first run; must not change after results are seen
rule_draft.saturation: saturation in Ns: doubling Ns gives < 1 p.p. (mean validation at 100k, same L and R)
rule_draft.diagnosis: the diagnosis is found if some variant of B brings layer-wise to >= 90 % of joint (f) at the same Ns (mean test, 3 seeds); if (b) works, the E018 page gets a note that its layer-wise was a weak control, not a reproduction of the paper recipe
rule_draft.shared: shared is better than independent if the difference is >= 1 p.p.
rule_draft.noise: thresholds in p.p. are compared with results/noise_floor.json (E024): MDD(5 seeds) = t_{0.975,8} * s_pooled * sqrt(2/5); 0.1 dB of Q2 = 6 p.p. at 10 %, 4.1 at 48 %, 3.0 at 66 %, 2.7 at 70 % (anchors); every table prints both
